label: prf:topological-mass-categorical
title: Categorical proof of the topological decomposition of mass
html:
One assembles the bound from three lemmas. Put \alpha = (\int_A \otimes \mathrm{id}) \circ \Delta \circ \varrho. By (eigenspace decomposition), the descent involution splits \alpha as \hat{\tau}_n(\alpha) + (\alpha - \hat{\tau}_n(\alpha)). Since the trace is linear, the trace value splits the same way:

  \mathrm{tr}(\alpha)
  =
  \mathrm{tr}(\hat{\tau}_n(\alpha)) +
  \mathrm{tr}(\alpha - \hat{\tau}_n(\alpha)).

By (descended term equals base mass), the first summand is \mathrm{tr}_{\mathrm{desc}}(\varrho), the trace of the base-level cycle \varrho_0. By (transient terms localise to blow-ups), the second summand is \sum_{i=1}^{N} \mathrm{tr}_{\mathrm{trans}}(\varrho, p_i). Taking norms, the triangle inequality gives

  \mathfrak{m}(\varrho)
  = \lVert \mathrm{tr}(\alpha) \rVert
  \le
  \bigl\lVert \mathrm{tr}_{\mathrm{desc}}(\varrho) \bigr\rVert +
  \sum_{i=1}^{N} \bigl\lVert \mathrm{tr}_{\mathrm{trans}}(\varrho, p_i) \bigr\rVert .

Orthogonality of the splitting with respect to the Frobenius norm would add squared norms, not norms, so it does not upgrade this bound to the equality of the topological decomposition of mass. \square
